The main takeaway from our work is that

the thermal comfort of occupants in Mediterranean climate can be improved by the implementation of architectural strategies such as: - The reduction of the glazed surface of the building envelope - The implementation of solar protection devices - The reduction of solar gain through the use of light colored materials - The reduction of air exchange through the building envelope - A better control of the indoor air quality - A better thermal insulation of the building envelope.
